rust_summary: a mob about to finish spawning, on the server just before `Mob.finalizeSpawn` (`native_finalize_spawn`).
doc_summary: `native_finalize_spawn(dimension, kind, pos, reason, spawner, difficulty, effective_difficulty, spawn_cancelled, skip)`: a mob about to finish spawning, just before vanilla's `Mob.finalizeSpawn` and only where vanilla 26.3 calls it; change the local difficulty (base 0 peaceful to 3 hard, and its effective value), set `spawn_cancelled` to keep the mob out, or cancel (the out `skip`) to skip the finalize and let the mob spawn. There is no entity id (the mob is usually not in the level yet; change its gear in `mob_spawned`); mobs placed during chunk generation and natural spawning are not covered yet. Bundles need "hooks": @API:finalize_spawn@.
